claims.claim: I want to sell the bike its just 3 month old and in good conditions

risks.risk: Exact motorcycle make/model/year and engine size are not readable, so the bike may not match the comparables used for pricing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bike’s identification: engine number/VIN/chassis plate (or a close-up of the model badge) plus a photo of the dashboard/odometer reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used motorcycle with unknown specs and assume worst-case for matching (use the cheapest comparable that only broadly fits).

risks.risk: “Good conditions” is not proven: possible hidden issues (engine, gearbox, electrics, tyres, brakes, tyres age).
risks.proof: Short video start-up + idle, then a slow ride showing brakes and indicators; plus close-ups of tyres tread, brake pads/discs, and chain/sprocket condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified condition (assume typical wear and potential minor faults).

risks.risk: Odometer/mileage and service history are unknown; “3 months old” could be inaccurate.
risks.proof: Photo of the odometer reading and any service booklet/receipt (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older/unknown mileage rather than “3 months old”.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the bike’s brand/model badge or engine/VIN/chassis plate (readable).
Send a photo of the odometer/dashboard showing mileage.
Send a short video: start-up, indicators, headlight, horn, and a slow ride to confirm brakes and gear shifting.
Send close-ups of tyres tread, chain/sprocket, and brake discs/pads.
response.reason: The photo shows a motorcycle but the make/model/year and key condition indicators (odometer, engine/ID, close-up condition) are not readable, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the comparables.
